name: File Transformation
description: Intercept and modify served jellyfin-web content (index.html etc.) without editing files or rebuilding jellyfin-web. Enables plugins like OpenWatchParty to inject their client scripts.
overview: v12 port of jellyfin-plugin-file-transformation (IAmParadox27, GPL-3.0). Harmony-patches the server web static-file pipeline to apply registered transformations.
